def process(fraudByPaymentMethod) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import re

    df = fraudByPaymentMethod.copy()
    # The real header row is at index 1
    df = df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
    df.columns = ["paymentMethod", "numReports", "totalLoss"]

    # Keep only rows that look like actual payment methods and have a $ loss like "$275M"
    df = df[df["paymentMethod"].notna() & df["totalLoss"].notna()].copy()
    df = df[~df["paymentMethod"].astype(str).str.startswith("#")]
    df = df[~df["paymentMethod"].astype(str).str.contains("Source:", na=False)]
    df = df[df["totalLoss"].astype(str).str.contains("\\$")]

    def parse_loss_to_millions(x: str):
        s = str(x).strip().replace(",", "")
        m = re.search(r"\$\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*([MBK]?)", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if not m:
            return None
        val = float(m.group(1))
        unit = (m.group(2) or "").upper()
        if unit == "B":
            return val * 1000.0
        if unit == "M" or unit == "":
            return val
        if unit == "K":
            return val / 1000.0
        return None

    df["lossMillions"] = df["totalLoss"].map(parse_loss_to_millions)
    df = df[df["lossMillions"].notna()].copy()

    return df[["paymentMethod", "numReports", "totalLoss", "lossMillions"]]
